definition: a thin moustache.
example_en: A thin moustache began to appear on the young man now.

definition: an office, building of the telecommunication department from where messages can be sent by telegraph; a telegraph office.
example_en: He went to the telegraph office to send a message.

definition: a draft of a law proposed to a lawmaking body; a bill.
example_en: That bill is still under discussion in the parliament.

definition: an exquisite gem.
example_en: An exquisite gem was shining in that necklace.

definition: a particular type of words in a prose composition .
example_en: That style of prose is found in that literary work.

definition: together - a) in or into one gathering, group, mass or place; b) in or into contact, collision, union, etc. with each other.
example_en: Both friends travelled together.

definition: a work which one is regularly engaged in; profession; occupation.
example_en: His occupation was carpentry.

definition: a card, slip or any other written paper, mentioning the discount allowed on the items being sold.
example_en: The discount slip was pasted at the shop's door.

definition: a riding or excursion on a horse, elephant, etc.
example_en: The children waited for the excursion ride on the elephant.

definition: (pl.) sixty persons.
example_en: Sixty persons had gathered for the meeting.

definition: a thorny plant, Meyna laxiflora ( = Vanguieria spinosa) of Rubiceae family.
example_en: The acacia plant was full of thorns.

definition: act of going into a liquid; an immersing of oneself.
example: ಆತ ನದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಅದ್ದಿಕೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಬಂದ.
example_en: He immersed himself once in the river and came back.

definition: not firm, taut or rigid; loose.
example_en: The rope was loose and not taut.

definition: the outer side, part or surface; outside.
example_en: The outside was drenched by the rain.

definition: to give or cause to birth to a new offspring; to develop one's progeny.
example_en: That bird gives birth to its offspring in the spring season.

definition: a woman who makes and sells garlands of flowers.
example_en: The flower-garland woman was selling flowers near the temple.

definition: a man who is weak in physical or mental strength; an ineffectual, useless man.
example_en: That weak, useless man could not manage any work.

definition: to sit - a) to rest the weight of the body upon the buttocks and the back of the thighs, as on a chair; to be seated; b) (quadrupeds) to rest on the haunches with the forelegs braced; c) (a bird) to perch or roos.
example_en: He sat down on the chair.

definition: a beam of sunrays entring into a hut, building, etc. through a small aperture that looks like a stick.
example: ಸಣ್ಣ ಕಿಂಡಿಯಿಂದ ಬಂದ ಪಗಲುಗೋಲು ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿದ್ದಿತು.
example_en: The beam of sunlight coming through the small hole fell on the floor.

definition: a man having evil thoughts or malicious, spiteful feelings.
example_en: The words of the malicious man hurt the people.

definition: he who develops.
example: ಆ ಬೆಳೆಗಾಱ ಹೊಸ ಬೆಳೆ ಪದ್ಧತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಚಯಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That developer introduced new farming methods.

definition: a game of chance played with stakes.
example_en: The game of chance was played in the palace courtyard.

definition: a disorder of the muscles of the eyes, as cross-eye, in which both eyes cannot be focused on the same point at the same time; strabismus.
example: ಮೆಳ್ಳಗಣ್ಣಿನಿಂದ ಅವನಿಗೆ ದೂರದ ವಸ್ತುಗಳು ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Because of his strabismus, he could not see distant objects clearly.

definition: to move (something) from where it is; to transfer, carry away; to remove.
example_en: He removed the stones from there.

definition: the act of taking hold of; an instance of seizing; seizure.
example_en: The police seized the thief.

definition: to make (a person, thing) excel.
example: ಅವನ ಸಾಧನೆ ಅವನನ್ನು ಎಲ್ಲರಲ್ಲಿ ಮೇಲುಗೈ ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: His achievement made him excel among all.

definition: an instrument for striking, as in driving animals or in punishing, typically consisting of a lash with a rigid handle; a whip.
example_en: The cowherd drove the oxen with a whip.

definition: a cutting or harvesting grain; mowing; reaping.
example: ರೈತರು ಭತ್ತದ ಅಭಿಲಾವ ಮಾಡಲು ಹೊಲಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋದರು.
example_en: The farmers went to the field to harvest the paddy.

definition: a division of a city; a colony; an extension.
example: ಅವನ ಕುಟುಂಬ ಹೊಸ ಕಾಲನಿಗೆ ವಾಸ ಮಾಡಲು ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: His family came to reside in the new colony.

definition: a harmonious agreement with something else or with one another; correspondence.
example_en: A harmonious correspondence was found between the two reports.

definition: the hair at the lower part of the abdomen surrounding the external genitals; pubes.
example_en: One should keep the pubic hair clean.

definition: to come or be lying across, hence, to cause an obstacle; to impede.
example: ಕಲ್ಲು ದಾರಿಯ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಅಡ್ಡೈಸಿ ನಡೆಯಲು ಕಷ್ಟವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The stone lay across the middle of the path and made walking difficult.

definition: a long, concave roof-tile.
example_en: They had roofed the old house with concave tiles.

definition: a person engaged in warfare or appointed for the purpose; a warrior.
example_en: That warrior was appointed to guard the border.

definition: a keeping in check or curbing; restraint.
example_en: One cannot achieve the goal without restraint of the mind.

definition: the condition of being young.
example_en: He was very energetic in his youth.

definition: a weapon consisting of a long shaft, with a pointed end, used for throwing at or stabbing; a spear.
example_en: The enemy soldier attacked with a spear.

definition: unpleasing to look at; aesthetically offensive or unattractive; ugly.
example_en: That mask looked ugly.

definition: an aimless shot.
example_en: His arrow was an aimless shot and missed the target.

definition: a dock from which the water can be emptied, used for building and repairing ships; a dry-dock.
example_en: The ship was moved to the dry-dock for repair.

definition: the plant Piper longum of Piperaceae family.
example_en: They use the root of the long pepper plant in medicine.

definition: to move or go forward or ahead.
example_en: The soldiers move forward towards the enemy.

definition: a troubled state of mind; worry; anxiety; distress.
example_en: The son's illness caused distress to the mother.

definition: to give food to; to feed.
example_en: The mother lovingly fed the child.

definition: of, relating to, made in, imported from or characteristic of the continent of Europe; relating to or characteristic of the people of the continent of Europe; European.
example: ಐರೋಪ್ಯ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಆಸಕ್ತಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: He had interest in European culture.

definition: one's stepfather's daughter or stepmother's daughter by another marriage, who is elder to oneself.
example: ಬಲ ಅಕ್ಕ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಹೊಸ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ತಂದುಕೊಟ್ಟಳು.
example_en: His elder stepsister brought him new clothes.

definition: the betel vine (Piper betle) of Piperaceae family.
example_en: The betel vine had been grown behind the house.

definition: a slab or a piece of stone having gem or gems in it.
example_en: That gem-bearing stone was used for making jewellery.

definition: an irritating sensation on the skin that makes one want to scratch the affected part; itch; tingling.
example_en: An itch has appeared on my hand and I feel like scratching it.

definition: perfumes, aromatic substances collectively.
example_en: Various perfumes were being sold in the shop.

definition: a thick lubricant used to reduce friction of the wheels of machines or vehicles.
example: ಯಂತ್ರದ ಚಕ್ರಗಳಿಗೆ ಕಂದನೆಯನ್ನು ಹಚ್ಚಿ ಘರ್ಷಣೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: They reduced friction by applying grease to the wheels of the machine.

definition: the act of mediation, pleading or praying in behalf of another or others.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ಹಿರಿಯರ ರದಬದಲಿ ಜಗಳ ಬಗೆಹರಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The elder's mediation resolved the quarrel between the two.

definition: flawless, exquisite beauty.
example_en: Flawless, exquisite beauty stood out on her face.

definition: the sun, the lord of the day.
example_en: The poet described the sun as the lord of the day.

definition: a clan of Tamil-speaking people.
example: ಆ ಮೊದಲಿಯಾರ್ ಕುಟುಂಬ ಇಡೀ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That Modaliyar family was famous throughout the region.

definition: a short pithy saying in general use, held to embody a general truth or popularly accepted as a truth; a proverb; an adage.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಹೇಳಿದ ಗಾಹೆ ನನಗೆ ಇಂದಿಗೂ ನೆನಪಿದೆ.
example_en: I still remember the proverb my grandmother told me.

definition: the activity or profession of a trader.
example_en: That community was famous for trading.

definition: to perform or accomplish in an excellent manner.
example_en: He performed his work in an excellent manner.

definition: an open porch, usu. roofed, extending across the front side of a house; a verandah.
example_en: Grandfather was sitting in the verandah at the front of the house.

definition: to keep (something) at the back of.
example: ಆ ಫೈಲನ್ನು ಸದ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಪಿಂತಿರಿಸಿ ಇಡುವಂತೆ ಹೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: He asked to keep that file at the back for now.

definition: (dial.) refined lac, a resin usually produced in thin, flaky layers or shells and used in making varnish, sealing packets etc.
example_en: Refined lac is used in making varnish.

definition: that which is broaked, cracked.
example_en: They threw away that cracked glass.

definition: a part or fragment broken or separated from the whole; a piece.
example: ಒಡೆದ ಕುಡಿಕೆಯ ತುಮುರು ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿದ್ದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A fragment of the broken pot lay on the ground.

definition: to spread out oneself in all direction and widely; to diffuse oneself.
example_en: The news spread out all over the village.

definition: to become solid, compact, etc. as from freezing; to solidify.
example_en: The water kept in the fridge quickly solidified.

definition: shaking; vibrating; quivering.
example_en: The ground was shaking from the earthquake.

definition: a man or boy whose work is tending, feeding, and currying horses; a groom.
example_en: The palace groom fed fodder to the horses.

definition: to cause to shrink in volume; to contract.
example_en: The leaf shrank in the sunlight.

definition: to sit on a chair or any other seat.
example_en: The king sat on the seat and addressed the subjects.

definition: the act of pairing two similar things together.
example: ಅವನು ಎರಡು ಸೀರೆಗಳ ಜೋಳಿಗಟ್ಟು ಮಾಡಿ ಮಾರಿದನು.
example_en: He paired up two similar saris and sold them.

definition: that which is smeared, daubed with.
example_en: That cloth was smeared with oil.

definition: a man whose occupation is to cook; a cook.
example_en: That cook prepared a tasty dish.

definition: to move slightly but repeatedly up and down, back and forth or from side to side.
example_en: The boat kept swaying slightly in the water.

definition: that which never decays, spoiled or ruined; an eternal thing.
example_en: The idol of that temple remains eternally undecayed.

definition: an interjection used a) to express wonder or b) when something is remembered suddenly.
example_en: Oh! What a wonder this is!

definition: an opening in a wall or roof to bring in fresh air and drive out foul air; a ventilator.
example_en: Fresh air was coming in through the ventilator on the wall.

definition: a strong, metal or wooden box.
example_en: The queen's strong box was filled with gold jewellery.

definition: (hist.) a heavy quill or feather trimmed to a split point, used for writing with ink.
example_en: In olden times, people used to write with a quill pen.

definition: to play in the dust.
example_en: The children played in the courtyard, playing in the dust.

definition: (pl.) the two sides.
example_en: The soldiers surrounded the enemy from both sides.

definition: a Hindu movement advocating a monotheistic religion based on the Upanishads, and social and educational reforms according to Western principles; Brahma Samāja.
example_en: The Brahma Samaja worked for social reform.

definition: a melodious sound or tone.
example_en: The melodious tone of that song was pleasant to the ears.

definition: a mineral (complex silicate) that crystallizes in thin, somewhat flexible, translucent or coloured, easily separated layers, resistant to heat and electricity; mica.
example_en: This rock contains an abundance of mica.

definition: a stone slab to recline on.
example: ಮುದುಕ ಮರದ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಆನುಂ ಪಾಸಱೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಒರಗಿಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: The old man reclined on the stone slab under the tree.

definition: an impertinent, imprudent or officious talk.
example: ಹಿರಿಯರ ಮುಂದೆ ಅವನ ತಲೆಮಾತು ಯಾರಿಗೂ ಇಷ್ಟವಾಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: No one liked his impertinent talk in front of the elders.

definition: to gain or become success; to win.
example_en: The soldiers gained victory in the war.

definition: the quality or condition of being tender; tenderness.
example_en: The tenderness of this leaf looks pleasant.

definition: great alarm; intense fear.
example_en: That news caused great alarm among the people.

definition: a man with the nose chopped off.
example_en: People showed pity to the man whose nose had been chopped off.

definition: the tree Psidium guajava ( = P. pyriferum) of Myrtaceae family.
example_en: A guava tree has grown in the courtyard.

definition: filled with or covered by smoke.
example_en: The burnt house was covered with smoke.

definition: the sun, the lord of the day.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಕಾವ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೂರ್ಯನನ್ನು ಪಗಲಾಣ್ಮ ಎಂದು ಕರೆದಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: In the old poetry, the sun has been called the lord of the day.

definition: the use of false representations to gain unjust advantage; the quality of being deceitful; fraud.
example_en: His fraud was soon exposed.

definition: the moon, esp. the crescent moon.
example_en: The crescent moon had risen in the sky.

definition: (the bones of the body) to protrude due to loss of flesh.
example_en: Because of hunger, the bones of his body protruded.

definition: the state or quality of being bound together.
example: ಈ ಎರಡು ಸಂಗತಿಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಅನುಬದ್ಧತೆ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: The state of being bound together between these two matters is clear.

definition: to withdraw, retire or draw back; to retreat.
example_en: The army retreated, frightened by the enemy's attack.

definition: a man and a woman who are married to each other; a couple.
example_en: That married couple went to the temple together.

definition: rent paid or to be paid in cash for a leased agricultural land.
example_en: This year the cash rent for the land was fixed.

definition: a looking obliquely.
example_en: He looked at me obliquely.

definition: loss of judgement power, intelligence or wisdom; madness.
example_en: After the accident, he suffered from madness.

definition: lack of normal function of the testes; the quality or state of being an eunuch.
example: ಆ ಎತ್ತಿಗೆ ಷಂಡತನ ಇರುವುದರಿಂದ ಸಂತಾನ ಬರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Since that bull had lost function of its testes, it could not sire offspring.

definition: (said of birds) to return to (one's) nest.
example_en: As evening fell, the birds flew back to return to their nests.

definition: the act of stealing.
example_en: His act of stealing came to light.

definition: to solemnly declare, in the name of a god, to do or refrain from doing something to pledge oneself to something; to undertake a vow.
example: ಗ್ರಾಮದೇವತೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ಹಾೞಂಬಟ್ಟು ಅವನು ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He took a solemn oath, undertaking a vow before the village deity.

definition: a seller of or dealer in gold ornaments and others articles.
example_en: Gold ornaments are available at the gold dealer's shop.

definition: excretion from the body, as sweat, etc.
example_en: When one works in the sun, bodily excretion (sweat) increases.

definition: large, huge; very big.
example: ಆ ಗರದಿ ಮರದ ನೆರಳಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯವರು ವಿಶ್ರಮಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The villagers rested in the shade of that huge tree.

definition: the act or fact of keeping awake and alert, in order to look after, protect or guard; a watch; a vigil.
example_en: He kept watch all night and guarded against the thieves.

definition: totalling to fourteen.
example_en: There were fourteen books in that box.

definition: to attack in a forceful, violent, hostile or aggressive way.
example_en: The tiger suddenly attacked the deer aggressively.

definition: a minor, feeble god.
example_en: They used to worship a minor, feeble god in that shrine.

definition: tender and loving; affectionate.
example_en: His affectionate words drew everyone in.

definition: one who indicts or charges; a complainant.
example_en: In the court, the complainant presented his witnesses.

definition: any of a series of intermittent breaths, as from a disease or bodily disorder.
example_en: Hearing the patient's intermittent breaths, the doctor became alarmed.

definition: to be accomplished, fulfilled fully.
example_en: That task was fully accomplished.

definition: a face with the countenance of joy, jubilee, health, etc.
example: ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗೆದ್ದ ಹುಡುಗನ ಮುಖದಲ್ಲಿ ಗೆಲುಮೊಗ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The joyful, triumphant face of the boy who won the exam was visible.

definition: a contemplative saint; an ascetic.
example: ಆ ಜೋಗಿ ಊರೂರು ಅಲೆಯುತ್ತಾ ಭಿಕ್ಷೆ ಬೇಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That ascetic wandered from village to village begging alms.

definition: an instrument for the precise measurement of boiling points; an ebullioscope.
example_en: The scientist measured the boiling point of water with the ebullioscope.

definition: sparkling light.
example: ರಾತ್ರಿಯ ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿ ನಕ್ಷತ್ರಗಳ ಮಿನ್ನು ಕಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಇಂಪಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The sparkling light of the stars in the night sky was pleasing to the eye.

definition: to become adhesive, sticky.
example_en: The glue dried in the air and became sticky.

definition: to heed to what one is told.
example_en: The disciple heeded to what the teacher said.

definition: the act of becoming reduced in size, number or extent; a reducing or being reduced.
example_en: Due to the drought, there was a reduction in the crop.

definition: the curls or hair hanging down at the back of the head.
example_en: Her curls hanging at the back swayed over her back.

definition: to pain with a red pigment.
example_en: She painted the wall with a red pigment.

definition: to attain eminence.
example_en: He attained eminence through hard labor.

definition: a way, path, road.
example: ಊರಿಗೆ ಹೋಗುವ ಬಳಿ ಕಾಡಿನ ಮೂಲಕ ಸಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The road to the village passes through the forest.

definition: a fruit in its very early stage of development.
example_en: There are still early-stage fruits on the tree.

definition: a sliding down accidentally on a slippery surface; an act of slipping and falling down.
example_en: He slipped and fell accidentally in the rain.

definition: to divide (something) and distribute between or among.
example_en: The servants divided the rice and distributed it to the devotees.

definition: a woman lacking feminine qualities or characteristics.
example_en: The villagers called her a woman lacking feminine qualities.

definition: super-heated.
example_en: This metal melts in a super-heated state.

definition: the act of touching one's forehead several times as a gesture of greeting another cordially.
example_en: He greeted the king respectfully with a salutation.

definition: a face with brows contracted, as in sternness, anger, disapproval, etc.; a grim or sullen face; a frowning countenance.
example_en: In anger, his face became a sullen, frowning face.

definition: something said or written in return to a question, argument, letter, etc.; an answer.
example_en: He forgot to write a reply to the letter.

definition: the quality or condition of being dwarf, shorter or smaller than the usual one of one's species; shortness; dwarfishness.
example_en: His shortness drew everyone's attention.

definition: an interjection used in calling attention (of a respectable person or a peson of higher rank); 'attention please'.
example: ಸೇವಕನು 'ಪಾಯವಧಾರು' ಎಂದು ಕೂಗಿ ಜನರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆದನು.
example_en: The servant called out 'attention please' to draw the people's notice.

definition: a substance used for washing and cleansing purposes, usu. made by treating a fat with an alkali, as sodium or potassium hydroxide; a soap.
example_en: She used soap to wash her hands.

definition: (dial.) a small barrier to avoid flowing down of rain water.
example_en: The villagers built a small barrier for the rainwater.

definition: a place where the underground water comes forth or oozes.
example_en: There was a spot near the rock where underground water oozed out.

definition: a kind of ant.
example_en: This kind of ant had built a nest in the crack of the wall.

definition: a regular and repeated circuit of (an area, town, camp, etc.) in guarding; a patrolling.
example_en: The police kept patrolling the whole night.

definition: an office or building where mail is sorted for distribution, postage stamps are sold, etc.; a post office.
example: ಅಂಚೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸಲು ಅವನು ಹತ್ತಿರದ ಪೋಸ್ಟ್‌ಗೆ ಹೋದನು.
example_en: He went to the nearby post office to send the mail.

definition: a track of way worn by footsteps in a forest.
example_en: The track worn by footsteps passed through the inside of the forest.

definition: a building or outdoor structure designed for presentation of films; a cinema hall; a theatre.
example_en: On Saturday evening they went to the cinema hall.

definition: a multitude or group of enemies.
example_en: The king's multitude of enemies surrounded him.

definition: to become putrid or rotten and emit rancid smell.
example_en: The milk left in the sun turned putrid.

definition: the bean plant Dolichos lablab (= Lablab niger) of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: They used the bean pods for the vegetable dish.

definition: the four-horned antelope Tetraceros quadricornes.
example_en: A rare four-horned antelope appeared in the forest.

definition: a man who has invested capital in a business enterprise; an investor; a capitalist.
example: ಆ ಭಂಡವಾಳುಗಾರ ಹೊಸ ಕಾರ್ಖಾನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಣ ಹೂಡಿದನು.
example_en: That capitalist invested money in the new factory.

definition: full of or characterised by whims or fancy; whimsical; capricious.
example: ಅವನ ಷೋದಾ ಸ್ವಭಾವ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಗೊಂದಲ ಮೂಡಿಸಿತು.
example_en: His whimsical nature confused everyone.

definition: to shout aloud.
example: ಜನರು ಬೆಂಕಿ ಕಂಡು ರಟಿಸುತ್ತಾ ಓಡಿ ಬಂದರು.
example_en: People came running, shouting aloud on seeing the fire.

definition: a period of comfort.
example_en: The period of comfort of the holidays ended quickly.

definition: he who cleaves, breaks.
example: ಆ ನಿರ್ಭೇದಿ ಕಲ್ಲನ್ನು ಒಂದೇ ಬಾರಿಗೆ ಒಡೆದನು.
example_en: That breaker split the stone in a single blow.

definition: a very small earthenware.
example_en: She filled water in the small earthen pot.

definition: the nominative singular of the first personal pronoun; the word mentioning oneself; the one who is speaking or writing; " I ".
example: ಆಂ ಈ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಮಾಡಿದೆನು ಎಂದು ಅವನು ಹೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: He said, "I did this work."

definition: a man associates with or accompanies another or others; an associate; a comparison.
example_en: He was my companion since childhood.

definition: a man who is indebted or obliged to another under obligation, moral responsibility or gratitude.
example_en: He was obliged and indebted to that rich man.

definition: (the eye) to become blur; to be unable to see clearly.
example_en: His eyes became blurred from the smoke.

definition: hunted; killed in hunting.
example_en: The hunter brought the hunted animal home.

definition: cooked and cut areca nut.
example_en: They served the guests cooked and cut areca nut.

definition: he who gives unwise or evil advice.
example_en: Don't listen to that giver of evil advice.

definition: a foreign country.
example_en: His son is working in a foreign country.

definition: a kind of perennial plant.
example_en: Kadarakasa had grown on the field's edge.

definition: to make (something) clear, clean.
example_en: He made the dirty water clean and clear.

definition: he who creates; a creator.
example_en: It is believed that the Creator fashioned this world.

definition: a skin disease characterised by smooth, white patches on various parts of the body, caused by the loss of the natural pigment.
example_en: White patches of the skin disease appeared on his body.

definition: to be joined or fastened securely; to glue or stick oneself.
example_en: The two sticks got glued together securely.

definition: the state of one's foot being entangled in a stirrup.
example: ಕುದುರೆ ಓಡಿದಾಗ ಅವನ ಕಾಲು ಅಂಕಣೆದೊಡಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿಹಾಕಿಕೊಂಡಿತು.
example_en: When the horse ran, his foot got caught in the entanglement of the stirrup.

definition: (fig.) to hold another's feet submissively, esp. lacking one's self-respect, for a favour.
example_en: Needing help, he submissively held the rich man's feet.

definition: to cause (a flower) close (its petals.
example_en: As evening fell, that flower closed its petals.

definition: the act of hiding or providing a shade with one's hand.
example_en: In the sunlight, the grandmother shielded her eyes with her hand.

definition: forgiving; disposed to pardon; having lenient view towards releasing from punishment, retaliation, avenge, etc.
example_en: That teacher is of a very forgiving nature.

definition: a cursory, superficial look; an examining, checking of something only from a superficial look without probing deep into it.
example_en: He only glanced at the file with a cursory look.

definition: to be got, obtained.
example_en: He obtained the job only with great difficulty.

definition: the large, deciduous tree Tectona grandis of Verbenaceae family, with white flowers and hard yellowish-brown wood used for shipbuilding, furniture, etc.; teak.
example_en: They used strong teak wood for the door.

definition: afterwards; subsequently.
example: ಪಾಠ ಮುಗಿಸಿ ಬೞಿಕೆ ಗುರುಗಳು ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಕೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: After finishing the lesson, the teacher asked questions afterwards.
